entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so lost with all this.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken. It's just... we had an emergency right after it arrived. My son is in the military and was scheduled for a sudden deployment, but then he needed unexpected surgery. It was a whole ordeal.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your son's surgery went well and he is recovering.

Thank you. He is. But I was at the hospital with him for over a week, and with the deployment paperwork... I just completely forgot about this. I saw something online about a short return time and I got worried. I don't understand the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Please don't worry about it at all, I'm happy to clarify things for you. Let me just pull up your order details and our return policy. One moment.

Alright, I see it here. The VeloBand was delivered 19 days ago. Looking at our policy, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are perfectly fine. We can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Wait, really? 90 days? Oh, thank goodness. I must have misread it. That's such a relief after everything.

It's no problem at all. It's the least we can do. I also see here that you're a VIP member. As a small gesture for your loyalty and for the trouble you've been through, I've added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
That is so kind of you. Thank you, Charlie. You've really made my day much easier.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your son all the best with his recovery and deployment.
